title: FuriosaAI Secures $620M to Expand AI Semiconductor Operations
summary:
The Seoul-based semiconductor startup's worth increased to $2.9B, up from $735M in 2025, following the closure of its latest investment cycle. FuriosaAI raised $620M in a Series D round to accelerate the production of high-end AI chips designed to compete with industry leaders such as Nvidia.

Of the total capital raised, South Korea's National Growth Fund contributed $280M. The startup intends to use the fresh funding to scale its hardware ecosystem and capture a larger share of the global AI infrastructure market.
